paper.title: Machine Learning for Credit Risk Assessment in Banking
paper.abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to credit risk assessment using ensemble machine learning methods. We evaluate various models including gradient boosting, random forests, and neural networks on a dataset of 100,000 loan applications. Our results show that the proposed ensemble method achieves 94% accuracy in predicting loan defaults, outperforming traditional credit scoring methods by 12%.
